## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format --check .` pass

- [ ] Tests added or updated (images generated with Pillow, none committed)
- [ ] Respects the hard rules in CONTRIBUTING.md (never deletes user files outside Empty Trash, offline at runtime, no float16)
- [ ] No personal photos, paths or logs included
